# M4.2.1 — Multi-Model Benchmark Execution Engine

**Milestone**: M4 — Benchmarking & Evaluation  
**Labels**: `milestone-task`, `backend`, `frontend`, `benchmarking`, `ml-infrastructure`, `telemetry`  
**Status**: Completed  

## Description
Implements the core multi-model benchmark execution service for TokenPilot. Builds upon M4.1's reproducible dataset registry and canonical storage to execute benchmark prompts across configured workspace LLMs (local and remote OpenAI-compatible, Hugging Face Inference Providers, and dedicated endpoints) and capture comprehensive inference telemetry. Reuses existing inference gateway adapters in-process without looping back over HTTP. Strictly enforces the Zero-Secret Credential Policy, SSRF prevention, GSM8K prompt scope, and split discipline. Keeps generation decoupled from scoring in preparation for M4.2.2.

---

## Acceptance Criteria Checklist

- [x] **1. BenchmarkRun Lifecycle & Execution Service**:
  - Implements reliable lifecycle state machine: `pending` -> `running` -> `completed` | `completed_with_errors` | `failed` | `cancelled`.
  - Background asynchronous task execution via `BenchmarkRunner` with active job tracking and cancellation token support.
  - Safe in-process persistence to `data/benchmark_runs/{run_id}.run.json` and `data/benchmark_runs/{run_id}.results.jsonl`.

- [x] **2. Reuse Existing Inference Gateway Without HTTP Loopback**:
  - Reuses existing provider adapters (`OpenAICompatibleAdapter`, `HFInferenceProvidersAdapter`) via internal runner `execute_internal_inference`.
  - Consumes server-sent event (SSE) stream chunks directly in-process to assemble final assistant text, token counts, time-to-first-token (TTFT), total latency, and finish reason.
  - Avoids opening redundant outbound HTTP requests back to TokenPilot's own `/api/gateway/chat/completions` endpoint.

- [x] **3. Strict Credential Exclusion & Zero-Secret Policy**:
  - Transient API keys (`transient_credential`) are accepted in-memory as Pydantic `SecretStr` marked with `exclude=True`.
  - Credentials are never serialized to `.run.json`, `.results.jsonl`, API responses, error logs, or export artifacts.
  - Verified by unit tests asserting that tokens never appear in serialized output.

- [x] **4. SSRF Protection & URL Sanitization**:
  - Validates all model base URLs using `validate_outbound_url` from `app.core.network_validator`.
  - Rejects attempts to access cloud metadata endpoints (`169.254.169.254`, `metadata.google.internal`), loopback addresses, or invalid schemes.

- [x] **5. Dataset Handling & GSM8K Scope Enforcement**:
  - Reads canonical imported records and manifests from `DatasetStorageManager` (`data/datasets/`).
  - Immutably preserves source revision, source split, and evaluation role (`held_out_test`).
  - Supports deterministic subset selection using fixed random seeds (default `42`).
  - Strictly rejects HumanEval datasets with a clear 422 validation message: code execution is deferred until sandboxed containers are introduced in M4.3+.

- [x] **6. Telemetry & Cost Accounting**:
  - Measures total latency (ms) and time to first token (TTFT ms).
  - Captures provider-reported prompt and completion token counts when supplied; marks provenance as `provider_reported`, `estimated`, or `unavailable`.
  - Captures model pricing snapshots (`PricingSnapshot`) at run initiation.
  - Computes `cost_usd` only when verified pricing and token counts are present; distinguishes unpriced/unavailable cost from zero-cost local inference.

- [x] **7. GSM8K Scoring Preparation (Separation of Generation & Scoring)**:
  - Captures raw model completion text and canonical reference answer metadata (`extracted_answer`).
  - Leaves `score` as `null` / unevaluated; does not assume success implies correctness. Full numeric extraction and scoring will be performed by M4.2.2.

- [x] **8. Fault Tolerance & Non-blocking Model Failures**:
  - Sequential multi-model evaluation loop ensures single model failure (timeout, 401, 429) records a failed `BenchmarkResult` without interrupting remaining models or dataset prompts.
  - Run concludes as `completed_with_errors` if any individual record fails, or `completed` if all succeed.

- [x] **9. Cancellation Semantics**:
  - Cancelling an active run flags internal cancellation token, halts scheduling of subsequent prompts, and marks terminal state as `cancelled`.
  - Immediate responsive cancellation verified by automated tests.

- [x] **10. REST API Endpoints**:
  - `POST /api/benchmarks/runs`: Validates manifest and models, snapshots pricing, starts background execution.
  - `GET /api/benchmarks/runs`: Lists all historical and active benchmark runs.
  - `GET /api/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}`: Retrieves run status and progress telemetry.
  - `GET /api/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}/results`: Paginated retrieval of evaluated canonical results.
  - `POST /api/benchmarks/runs/{run_id}/cancel`: Halts active run.

- [x] **11. Benchmark Lab Frontend Integration**:
  - Added "Benchmark Evaluation Runs" tab alongside dataset tabs.
  - "Run Benchmark" modal allows selecting enabled workspace models, configuring subset size, temperature, max tokens, and entering transient tokens.
  - Active run banner with live polling, progress bar, item counters, and cancel button.
  - "View Results" inspection modal with search filtering, latency, tokens, cost badges, prompt inspection, and assistant response preview.

- [x] **12. Automated Verification**:
  - 91 backend pytest tests passing (unit tests for internal inference runner, multi-model execution, error resilience, cancellation, SSRF blocking, HumanEval refusal, zero credential serialization, and API endpoints).
  - 50 frontend Vitest tests passing.
  - Production TypeScript and Vite build (`npm run build`) compiles with 0 errors.
